# Prompt brief

Fill this in before writing an image or video prompt. One line each. If a line is blank, you are about to get the default.

```
Use:            where it will appear (thumbnail, poster, shot 3 of 5)
Medium:         e.g. gouache, linocut, 35mm film, riso print, marker sketch
Subject:        who or what, doing one thing
Light:          ONE source, direction, quality (low window light from the left)
Palette:        3 to 5 named colors, one accent
Composition:    framing, viewpoint, which side is empty; off center
One imperfection: grain, misregistration, worn edge, slight blur, a messy object
Keep out:       text, hands, extra people, logos, brand names, clutter
For video add:  shot length, camera move and why, start frame reference
```

## Rules for the brief

- One style only.
- Name no living artist's style without the user's say-so.
- Write "no text in the image" and add real type afterward.
- Real people: only with consent.

## Example (image)

```
Use:            poster for a school bake sale
Medium:         risograph, two inks, cream paper
Subject:        a baker at a flour-dusted bench
Light:          window, from the left
Palette:        red, teal, cream
Composition:    cropped at the shoulder, subject right, empty space left
One imperfection: ink misregistration
Keep out:       text, close-up hands, logos
```

## Example (video shot)

```
Use:            shot 3 of 5, 4 seconds
Medium:         16mm film look
Subject:        a chef tastes from a spoon, looks off frame left
Light:          window from the right
Palette:        warm grey, steel, one red apron
Composition:    medium, handheld, subject left third
One imperfection: slight focus hunt
Keep out:       text, close-up hands, a second person
Start frame:    chef_ref.png
```

## Edit prompt

"Change only the background to X. Keep the face, pose, light, palette and crop the same."
